- Изменена ссылка в атрибуции с @maya_logs на t.me/maya_logs.
- Других изменений в функционале и правилах составления претензии нет.

- Attribution section updated: контакт "Создан @aggel008 · AI-канал: t.me/attentionlog · @maya_logs" заменён на более краткий "t.me/attentionlog · @maya_logs".
- Версия обновлена до 1.0.1.

Initial release — quickly generate formal Russian claims and complaints for banks, shops, housing services, government agencies, or employers.

- Guides user with clarifying questions, then drafts a formal complaint or claim based on input
- Automatically determines document type (досудебная претензия или жалоба) and recipient
- Uses detailed templates tailored for Russian regulations and practice
- Ensures formal tone, clear facts, and precise requirements
- Offers basic cross-promotion for related skills if used fewer than three times
